tools.name: recommend_skills
tools.description: Recommend agent skills (SKILL.md) that fit a coding project, for Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Copilot or Gemini CLI. Pass stack tags (best), a one line description, or a public GitHub repo URL. With no input it returns a sample for a Next.js project. Returns how many of 90,454 indexed skills fit, 2 f

tools.name: search_skills
tools.description: Search 90,454 open-license agent skills (SKILL.md) by task, tool or framework, for example "stripe webhooks", "playwright tests", "django admin" or "terraform aws". Returns the match count, the top 2 skills with license and install command, and a link to the full ranked list ($9 once). Read-only, no

tools.name: list_skill_tags
tools.description: List the stack tags (frameworks, languages, services) and task tags (testing, code-review, security and more) that recommend_skills accepts, with the size of the skill index. No input needed. Read-only.
